archimate:ValueStream.name: VS-08.4 Develop / Document New Methodologies or Tools
archimate:ValueStream.documentation:
er a method is proven, it must be made reusable. In this step, the organization turns a tested idea into a documented, standardized asset. This can be: - a methodological guideline, - a processing pattern, - a code template, - a reference implementation, - or an architectural building block.
Documentation includes: purpose, inputs, outputs, assumptions, quality effects, and links to governance rules. This makes the innovation usable by other teams, other domains, or even other national institutes.
Value created: Reusable, documented innovation assets — not one-off experiments.
